title: CashGuard mock savings products (backend/data/products.json)
description: The mock product catalogue (arch 4.4, 16.5): fictional products and rates, always mock. Read by the seed (B12), GET /products (B6b) and the ranking (C12). Load strictly (Decimal, no duplicate keys, no NaN), as tests/unit/datafiles.py parse_json does.

name.description: The product's (Romanian) name, as in arch 16.5.

rate.description: Fictional annual rate as a fraction (0.0350 = 3.5%).

min_months.description: The savings horizon (months until the money is needed) this product suits: from.

mock.description: Always true: the challenge requires a mock catalogue; the UI labels it.
